mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(token_input), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(token_output), 0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(token_total), 0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS call_count FROM opc_agent_token_usage WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND DATE_FORMAT(biz_date, '%Y-%m') = #{period}
